request: Build a small Node.js todo library (CommonJS, file todo.js) with an in-memory store: add todos, list them, and mark them complete.

requirements.description: Users can add a todo with a title
acceptanceCriteria: createStore().add(title) returns a todo { id, title, done: false } with a unique numeric id
add rejects an empty or whitespace-only title by throwing an Error

requirements.description: Users can list todos in insertion order
acceptanceCriteria: store.list() returns all todos in the order they were added
Mutating the returned array does not change the store

requirements.description: Users can mark a todo complete
acceptanceCriteria: store.complete(id) sets done to true and returns the updated todo
complete throws an Error for an unknown id

tasks.title: Implement the todo store
tasks.description: Create todo.js exporting createStore(), which returns an object with add, list and complete methods, as described by the acceptance criteria.
